summary: Improve cross-functional handoffs, role clarity and team decisions with practical RACI, DACI and SIPOC exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Cross-functional team training helps team leads, project coordinators and functional specialists coordinate shared work across functions. Through practical team scenarios, participants map handoffs with SIPOC, clarify roles and decision ownership using RACI and DACI, set shared measures and stakeholder updates, and draft working agreements and conflict-conversation plans; team-development stages receive foundation-level coverage.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who coordinate work across functions and need clearer ownership, dependable handoffs and shared progress measures.
prerequisites: No specialist framework knowledge or programming is required. Basic experience working with colleagues from another function will help you apply the exercises to familiar situations.
